title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: The family is excited to witness Pallavan receiving his degree at the convocation. Although happy about his achievement, Nadesan is hesitant to attend due to Pallavan's resentment.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: While Madhu is with Arjun, her father promises her to Shyam. Despite Madhu's refusal, her mother presents her to Shyam's family, pushing Madhu to reject Shyam as she loves Arjun.

title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu protests on stage, demanding a valid reason for Kanmani's rejection. The judges relent and give her a chance, and Kanmani impresses them with her presentation.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Upset by Vadivu's outburst, Muthuvel checks with Sakthivel and Pandian, who invites the family for lunch. Meanwhile, Palanivel rejoices as Suganya delivers a baby girl.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Selvam alerts Muthu about Raghu's suspected role in the cancelled bookings. Muthu approaches Raghu for help buying a used bus, hoping to build a friendly relationship.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Abinaya panics over the name board. After Maran's men attack Vetri, Shanmugam opposes his job at Sandhya's office while Sudar and Abinaya quietly worry over his recovery.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: Ilamathi avoids revealing the DNA results to Viji and Paraman. Kalamma takes a bribe from Pasupathy to help him obtain the pond desilting contract from Paraman.
